地底石室阴气沉沉，四道中级式神从四角阴影中猛然扑出。

身形佝偻扭曲，皮肉干瘪发黑，指尖利爪足有半寸长，泛着幽绿毒光，周身缠绕浓稠黑雾，每一次蠕动爬行，都带着刺骨的阴冷戾气。

比起村口被雷法瞬杀的低级式神，这四尊明显强悍数倍，不仅速度更快、肉身更硬，还懂得配合合围，封锁二人进退路线。

“分头牵制，逐个灭杀。”范梦雪冷声开口，手中雷木法尺挥动，一道粗壮雷刃劈向正面扑来的一尊式神。

银白雷光撕裂昏暗石室，空气被雷力灼得微微发烫。

式神嘶吼一声，黑雾暴涨，硬生生在身前凝成一面漆黑雾盾。

咔嚓！

雷刃劈中雾盾，黑雾剧烈翻腾、飞速消融，式神被震得连连后退，躯体表面冒出阵阵黑烟，显然至阳雷力对它克制极强。

胡九郎立身阵眼中央，神色淡漠，丝毫没有被四尊式神合围的紧迫感。

他一手捏诀，一手操控凌空悬浮的朱砂符箓，剩余一张符纸化作赤红火光，直冲向最后一口未封印的阴棺。

火光印上棺身，符文流转，棺内原本躁动不安的阴煞瞬间被强行镇压，再无半点异动。

四口阴棺尽数封死，石室四方的煞气源头被彻底掐断。

中央巨型祭阵失去阴棺供养，阵纹光芒肉眼可见黯淡下去，地底涌动的阴气暗流也随之减弱几分。

“先破阵，再斩式神。”胡九郎眸光微凝，脚步踏走八卦方位，周身隐隐泛起淡金色卦纹。

先天八卦步法踏出，身形飘忽不定，轻易避开两尊式神的利爪突袭。他指尖凝起一道灵气，隔空点向地面祭阵最中心的阵眼凹陷处。

灵气落处，阵纹剧烈震颤，黑色光芒忽明忽暗，地底传来沉闷的轰鸣，整座石室都微微晃动。

四道式神见阵法被破，越发狂暴，舍弃范梦雪，齐齐朝着胡九郎猛扑而来，想要拼死阻拦。

“别想干扰！”

范梦雪玉指结印，头顶雷光汇聚越来越盛，石室顶部仿佛隐有雷鸣滚动。“神霄正法，雷锁八方！”

漫天雷光化作无数细密雷丝，纵横交错，结成一道密闭雷网，瞬间笼罩整片石室。

The underground stone room was gloomy, and four intermediate shikigami suddenly jumped out from the shadows in the four corners.

The figure was rickety and twisted, with shriveled and blackened skin. The sharp claws on the fingertips were half an inch long, glowing with a green poisonous light. Thick black mist was wrapped around the body. Every time he squirmed and crawled, there was a biting cold and vicious aura.

Compared with the low-level shikigami who were instantly killed by lightning at the entrance of the village, these four were obviously many times stronger. Not only were they faster and physically tougher, they also knew how to cooperate with the encirclement and block the two's advance and retreat routes.

"Separately contain them and kill them one by one." Fan Mengxue said coldly, waving the Thunderwood Ruler in his hand, and a thick thunder blade struck at a shikigami rushing towards him.

The silver-white lightning tore through the dark stone room, and the air was slightly hot due to the thunder's power.

The shikigami roared, and the black mist surged, condensing into a dark mist shield in front of him.

Click!

The thunder blade hit the fog shield, and the black mist rolled violently and melted rapidly. The shikigami was shocked and retreated continuously, and bursts of black smoke appeared from the surface of the body. It was obvious that Zhiyang's thunder power was very strong against it.

Hu Jiulang stood in the center of the formation with an indifferent expression, showing no sense of urgency as he was surrounded by four shikigami.

He kneaded the secret with one hand and controlled the cinnabar talisman suspended in the air with the other. The remaining talisman turned into red flames and rushed straight towards the last unsealed Yin coffin.

The fire light stamped on the coffin body, the runes circulated, and the restless Yin evil inside the coffin was instantly suppressed, and there was no more movement.

All four Yin coffins were sealed, and the sources of evil energy in all directions of the stone chamber were completely cut off.

The giant central sacrificial array lost the support of the Yin coffin, and the light of the array pattern dimmed visibly to the naked eye, and the undercurrent of Yin energy surging underground also weakened a bit.

"First break the formation, then kill the shikigami." Hu Jiulang's eyes narrowed slightly, and he stepped in the Bagua direction, with faint golden hexagram patterns appearing all over his body.

He stepped out with the innate Bagua footwork and his figure was erratic, easily avoiding the sharp claw attacks of the two shikigami.He condensed a spiritual energy at his fingertips and pointed it towards the sunken center of the formation on the ground.

Where the spiritual energy fell, the formations trembled violently, the black light flickered on and off, a dull roar came from the ground, and the entire stone chamber shook slightly.

Seeing that the formation was broken, the four shikigami became even more violent. They abandoned Fan Mengxue and rushed towards Hu Jiulang, trying desperately to stop him.

"Don't try to interfere!"

Fan Mengxue made a seal with her jade fingers, and the thunder light above her head became more and more intense. There seemed to be hidden thunder rolling on the top of the stone chamber."Shenxiao rectifies the Dharma, and thunder locks all directions!"

The thunder light all over the sky turned into countless fine lightning threads, crisscrossing each other, forming a closed thunder net that instantly enveloped the entire stone chamber.
